title: The CI dashboard type check could never pass: the test job installs only the root packages, so dashboard/tsconfig.json cannot find React; no CI run has gone green since the step was added on 2026-04-29
severity_rationale: S3: a check that cannot pass protects nothing and would have kept CI red once the earlier steps were fixed. No production path is involved.

evidence.note: The step type-checks dashboard/tsconfig.json; the job has one npm ci, at the repo root.

evidence.ref: clean-clone replay of the CI steps at 776858c, Node 22.16.0
evidence.note: tsc exit 2 with 952 errors, led by TS2307 cannot find module react.

evidence.ref: clean-clone replay with npm ci --prefix dashboard added

sibling_sites_checked: The test job is the only job that reads dashboard/. The hardhat-compile, slither and mythril jobs use only the root packages.
red_proof: Without the install step the type check exits 2 with 952 errors; with it, exit 0.
recommendation: Done: ea193b8 adds npm ci --prefix dashboard before the type check.
